annotations.title: What waits for the person, across every app

description: The home page's What now for every app of the workspace in one call: the requests waiting for a person's approval (App Review, production, prices, testers, files), the builds and steps that failed or stopped, and what's on its way. Use it at the start of the work and when the person asks what's going on; for one app's stores in detail, ploa_shipping_report.
name: ploa_what_now
